status: frozen after v18B readiness passed and before constructing either member-stress map or reading any replacement-pair lensing target
purpose: Construct target-blind projected collisionless baryonic stress maps on the spent MACS J0416 and PLCK G287 replacement pair with one universal selection, stellar-mass rule, and adaptive coarse-graining rule.

grid.coordinate_convention: x positive east and y positive north

adaptive_kernel.bandwidth_equation: sigma_i=d_i,k/2, where d_i,k is the projected distance to member i's kth nearest selected member
adaptive_kernel.local_mean_equation: vbar(x)=sum_i M_i K_i(x) v_i / sum_i M_i K_i(x)
adaptive_kernel.selection_rule: the primary rank is fixed before any map or target is constructed; sensitivities are reported and cannot be selected using lensing

lensing_geometry.role: dimensionless source-unit conversion only; no lensing target is read

authorization.required_readiness_status: completed Sigma v18B replacement-pair readiness audit

claim_boundary: These are measured-source diagnostics, not a gravity law or a dark-matter map.
Adaptive bandwidth is a target-blind estimator of the measured member phase-space field, not a physical Sigma propagation length.
A later transfer test must use all three one-metric channels and the same primary source construction in both clusters.
A passing transfer would still require a covariant action that generates the coarse-graining dynamically.
